headline: Fishermans Row Falls Still; Oarbreaker and Tempest Flare
war_summary: Since our last edition the fires have shifted. Fishermans Row, the day's busiest field at thirty-four actions, has fallen still, quiet some four hours, its nine points standing eight Warden to one Colonial. New flames rise elsewhere: on Oarbreaker, Warden captures are logged at Fort Fogwood and Posterus within two hours of press, casualties climbing hourly; Tempest Island's Surge Gate and Isle of Psyche saw action in the same span, one work left in ruin; and Stlican Shelf fought on inside the two hours, The Old Mourn and Vulpine Watch its pivots. Lykos Isle, whose ruin we lately reported, shows all seven points in keeping again, six Colonial to one Warden. The Dead Lands remain the great slaughter-yard — past eleven thousand Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden casualties in the day, the ground divided six Colonial to five Warden — though the hourly toll cools. In Linn Mercy no works have changed hands, yet the burn there rises fastest of any front, near a thousand Colonial and seven hundred Warden the hour. The ledger stands two hundred fifty Colonial works to one hundred eighty-five Warden, one in ruin — three to the Colonial good since our last accounting. It is the war's one-hundred-twenty-fifth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
